install.title: Install MuseTera
install.subtitle: Get faster access by installing our app

ios.title: How to install on iOS (Safari):
ios.step2: Scroll down and tap 'Add to Home Screen'

android.title: How to install on Android:
android.step1: Tap the menu (⋮) in the top right corner

desktop.title: How to install on Desktop:
desktop.step1: Click the install icon in the address bar
desktop.step2: Or go to Menu > Install MuseTera
